evidenceEntries.sourceTitle: Example policies to control access to the Amazon EC2 console — Use the EC2 launch instance wizard
evidenceEntries.rationale: Official AWS documentation states that the EC2 launch instance wizard cannot load AMIs, instance types, VPCs, subnets, security groups, or key pairs unless the corresponding Describe* actions are allowed in addition to ec2:RunInstances. Amazon EC2 Describe* APIs do not support resource-level permissions.

evidenceEntries.sourceTitle: Example policies for working with the AWS CLI or an AWS SDK — Launch instances (RunInstances)
evidenceEntries.rationale: Official AWS documentation states that launching into a VPC requires a subnet and creates a network interface, and launching from an Amazon EBS-backed AMI creates a volume. RunInstances therefore needs those supporting resource permissions in addition to launching the instance.
